name: Sex Pistols

whyMatters.en: London punk band, 1975–1978. EMI and A&M deals collapsed within months; Virgin issued Anarchy-era material. Never Mind the Bollocks and the Winterland close remain core UK punk reference points.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦朋克乐队，1975–1978。EMI 与 A&M 合约数月内破裂；Virgin 发行 Anarchy 时期作品。《Never Mind the Bollocks》与 Winterland 终场仍是英国朋克的核心参考。

note.en: EMI single. Jones on high-gain guitar; Lydon vocal; Matlock-era writing.
note.zh: EMI 单曲。Jones 高增益吉他；Lydon 人声；Matlock 时期写作。

note.en: Released during the Silver Jubilee year; BBC ban and chart disputes followed.
note.zh: 银禧年发行；随后有 BBC 禁播与榜单争议。

note.en: Open power-chord riff; Cook’s straight eighths on drums.
note.zh: 开放强力和弦 riff；Cook 直线八分鼓点。

interviewQuotes.text: We're not into music. We're into chaos.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Rotten

interviewQuotes.text: Ever get the feeling you've been cheated?
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Rotten

lyricQuotes: I am an antichrist / I am an anarchist
God save the queen, the fascist regime

shortBio.en: London punk, 1975–78. Rotten, Jones, Cook; Matlock then Vicious on bass. Anarchy in the U.K. and Never Mind the Bollocks are the core references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦朋克，1975–78。Rotten、Jones、Cook；贝斯先后为 Matlock 与 Vicious。《Anarchy in the U.K.》与《Never Mind the Bollocks》是主要参照。

body.en: London punk band, active mainly 1975–1978. Manager Malcolm McLaren had briefly worked with the New York Dolls; Johnny Rotten (John Lydon) joined after walking into the McLaren–Westwood shop in a self-altered Pink Floyd “I hate” T-shirt. Glen Matlock left in 1977; Sid Vicious replaced him. Never Mind the Bollocks Here’s the Sex Pistols (1977) reached UK #1. The US tour ended at Winterland, San Francisco, with a Stooges cover of No Fun.
body.zh: 伦敦朋克乐队，主要活跃于 1975–1978。经纪人 Malcolm McLaren 曾短暂管理 New York Dolls；Johnny Rotten（John Lydon）穿着自制“我讨厌”字样的 Pink Floyd T 恤走进 McLaren 与 Vivienne Westwood 的店后加入。1977 年 Glen Matlock 离队，Sid Vicious 接替。专辑《Never Mind the Bollocks Here’s the Sex Pistols》（1977）登上英国榜冠军。美国巡演收束于旧金山 Winterland，以 Stooges 翻唱《No Fun》收场。

body.en:
Short catalog, 1976–77: high-gain power chords, straight drums, Lydon’s spoken-sung vocal.

McLaren’s shop circuit and the Pink Floyd T-shirt story sit at the start; EMI then A&M signed and dropped the band within months before Virgin.
body.zh:
目录很短，集中在 1976–77：高增益强力和弦、直线鼓点、Lydon 的说唱式人声。

起点包括 McLaren 的店铺网络与 Pink Floyd T 恤；EMI、A&M 先后签约又解雇，随后才到 Virgin。

body.en:
Matlock wrote early material and left in 1977. The book repeats the Abba/Beatles liking story as the public reason.

Vicious joined; Lemmy (Motörhead) later said Vicious had little bass skill. Jones covered bass on many later recordings.
body.zh:
Matlock 写了早期作品，1977 年离队。书中沿用“喜欢 Abba 与 Beatles”这一公开说法。

Vicious 加入；Lemmy（Motörhead）后来说 Vicious 几乎不会弹贝斯。后期许多录音的贝斯由 Jones 完成。

alt.en: Johnny Rotten with Sex Pistols at Paradiso, Amsterdam, 1977
alt.zh: Johnny Rotten 与 Sex Pistols，阿姆斯特丹 Paradiso，1977

body.en:
Anarchy in the U.K. (1976) became the early flag. EMI and A&M deals collapsed inside half a year; the song EMI names both labels.

Never Mind the Bollocks (1977) hit UK album #1 after court and press panic around the sleeve. God Save the Queen was pushed off the singles top spot by Rod Stewart’s I Don’t Want to Talk About It—Jones later said Stewart’s album was the first record he bought.
body.zh:
《Anarchy in the U.K.》（1976）是早期标志。EMI 与 A&M 合约半年内破裂；歌曲《EMI》点名两家厂牌。

《Never Mind the Bollocks》（1977）在封面争议与诉讼之后登上英国专辑榜冠军。《God Save the Queen》被 Rod Stewart 的《I Don’t Want to Talk About It》挤下单曲榜首位——Jones 后来说 Stewart 的专辑是他买的第一张唱片。

body.en:
Steve Jones plays stacked power chords. Paul Cook keeps drums simple and loud. Lydon is the public face; the bass chair changes once.

After the band ended, Lydon formed Public Image Ltd.
body.zh:
Steve Jones 演奏叠置强力和弦。Paul Cook 鼓点简单且响。Lydon 是公开形象；贝斯席更换一次。

乐队结束后，Lydon 组建 Public Image Ltd。

title.zh: 媒体句与 Winterland 收场

body.en:
US Midwest and South dates met hostility. At Winterland, San Francisco, the last US show closed on a Stooges cover of No Fun. Rotten asked the crowd if they’d been cheated.

Rotten formed PiL; Cook and Jones formed The Professionals. Vicious died in 1979. 1996 Filthy Lucre Live reunited Lydon, Jones, Cook, and Matlock.
body.zh:
美国中西部与南部场次敌意很重。旧金山 Winterland 的美国末场以 Stooges 翻唱《No Fun》收束；Rotten 问观众是否感到被骗。

Rotten 组建 PiL；Cook 与 Jones 组建 The Professionals。Vicious 于 1979 年去世。1996 年《Filthy Lucre Live》由 Lydon、Jones、Cook 与 Matlock 重组巡演录成。

title.zh: 与 The Clash 并列的引用

body.en: Often paired with The Clash as the two best-known UK punk bands of 1976–77. Ramones’ 1976 UK visit is cited in the book as one spark Pistols members watched.
body.zh: 书中常把他们与 The Clash 并列，视为 1976–77 英国最知名的两支朋克乐队。Ramones 1976 年英国巡演也被记为 Pistols 成员看过的现场之一。

note.en: Jones and Cook started earlier; Matlock joined mid-1970s. McLaren’s New York Dolls management fed the project. Book notes Matlock was dismissed amid claims he liked Abba and The Beatles.
note.zh: Jones 与 Cook 更早成组；Matlock 于 1970 年代中加入。McLaren 管理 New York Dolls 的经历影响了这支乐队。书中写 Matlock 离队的说法之一是他喜欢 Abba 与 The Beatles。

note.en: Motörhead’s Lemmy tried to teach Vicious bass. Jones often played bass on post-Matlock recordings.
note.zh: Motörhead 的 Lemmy 曾尝试教 Vicious 弹贝斯。Matlock 离队后的录音里，贝斯常由 Jones 完成。

note.en: EMI single; Jones guitar and Lydon vocal as early UK punk markers.
note.zh: EMI 单曲；Jones 吉他与 Lydon 人声是早期英国朋克标记。

note.en: High-gain power chords and tabloid-scale press in under two years.
note.zh: 不到两年内完成高增益强力和弦与大规模媒体报道。
